title: MINA Pro — AI Mortgage Automation Platform
tagline: An AI co-pilot for mortgage teams — automating repetitive file work so loan officers spend less time on data entry and more time closing.
overview: MINA Pro (Machine Intelligent Navigation Assistant) is Fastrack Lending's internal AI operating system — a modular platform that connects a mortgage team's tools, automates repetitive workflows, and adapts to how the team actually works instead of forcing a rigid process onto them. As lead programmer, I built the platform on Bubble.io with OpenAI-powered automation, AWS infrastructure, and Stripe billing.
problem: Mortgage processing involves a lot of repetitive, error-prone manual work — moving the same file data between systems, chasing documents, and keeping every loan file moving without dropping anything. That work eats into the time loan officers should be spending with borrowers.
solution: Built a modular, SOC 2-aligned AI platform: a core CRM that centralizes clients, team, and data, plus add-on automation modules (AI, marketing, email, appointment automation) that teams turn on as they grow. The implementation process maps a team's existing workflow first, then automates the repetitive parts instead of forcing a new process on them.
results: Live and in use by Fastrack Lending's mortgage team, reducing manual file-handling work and the errors that come with moving data between disconnected tools by hand.
